title: Memory Types Compared
summary: Choose memory strategies, persist durable state, prevent context drift, and maintain task continuity — including Copilot Memory specifics tested directly on the exam.

blocks.text: **Scoping Rule:** Always scope memory to task-relevant information only. Storing everything causes context pollution → context drift → degraded decisions.
**Exam Tip:** Task must survive overnight or across multiple sessions → long-term or external memory + durable artifacts. In-context = lost when session ends.
